title: Safe computation segment
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states (including possibly the halting state), and let $P$ be a predicate on the tuple of work-tape head positions. For configurations $a$ and $b$ on a fixed input and a time $t$, the computation from $a$ reaches $b$ after exactly $t$ steps, avoids states in $F$ at every time strictly before $t$, and satisfies $P$ on the work-tape head positions at every time from $0$ through $t$; moreover, the state of $b$ is not in $F$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
A machine over that alphabet and state type
A set of optional states F
A predicate on work-tape head positions
Configurations a and b on the fixed input
